newsitem.title: USA: Calif Gov. appoints Contra Costa County supervisor.
newsitem.headline: Calif Gov. appoints Contra Costa County supervisor.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson on Monday appointed Joseph Canciamilla to the Contra Costa County Board of Supervisors.
The appointment allows Canciamilla, 41, to immediately assume the position that he was otherwise elected to begin in January.

Canciamilla has served on the Pittsburg, Calif., City Council since 1987, including terms as vice-mayor and mayor. He is a member of the county Local Agency Formation Committee and the Delta Diablo Sanitation District Board of Directors.
